title: Valvoline Instant Oil Change℠ Ranked No. 1 In Automotive Franchises
summary: Recognition in Entrepreneur magazine’s 2026 ranking reflects franchise network strength and consistent execution across the system. Valvoline Inc. (NYSE: VVV), the quick, easy, trusted leader in preventive automotive maintenance, has been recognized as No. 1 in the automotive franchise category in Entrepreneur magazine’s 2026 ranking. The new ranking recognizes the Top 10 Franchises in Every Industry across major industry categories. Valvoline Instant Oil Change earned its top ranking by building a strong franchise system based on a proven operating model, broad brand awareness, and a commitment to delivering quick, easy and trusted service. “This recognition demonstrates the strength of the Valvoline Instant Oil Change franchise system,” said Adam Worsham, Chief Franchising Officer at Valvoline Inc. “It highlights the performance of our franchise partners throughout the network and our shared dedication to providing quick, easy and trusted service in communities nationwide.” The
